prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results across most tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption copy, adoption hint, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, finish notification, home notification, sign_in hint, sign_in layout, and sign_in reorder because each has only 1 test.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path reorder changes across 2 tests.
Home wait_info changes were helpful in 1 test (+4.2%), while 3 other tests showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign changes hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Choose_path copy changes hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 2 tests.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Controls Practice Screen: Add a dedicated interactive onboarding screen right before final completion where users can test pet movement and visibility commands. (why: Multiple support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)
1: [home, new_flow] Pet Care Mini Game Wait Flow: Introduce a mini-game sub-flow while pet assets generate during the waiting phase to keep users engaged. (why: The home wait step takes a median of 201 seconds (mean over 38 minutes), leading to drop-offs while users wait idle.)
2: [adoption, hint] Photo Customization Quality Tips Hint: Display clear photo formatting and lighting hints on the custom photo upload step. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect due to invalid photo uploads.)
3: [finish, copy] Desktop Command Navigation Copy: Update final completion screen copy to explicitly highlight desktop shortcut keys and tray navigation commands. (why: Users submitted support requests after onboarding asking how to control, minimize, and interact with the desktop pet.)
4: [home, wait_info] Live Preparation Status Wait Info: Display detailed stage-by-stage status indicators and elapsed time estimates while pet files render. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336 seconds and accounts for significant funnel drop-off.)
5: [sign_in, incentive] Account Data Preservation Incentive: Show a cloud save protection badge on sign in explaining that progress and pet customization are backed up instantly. (why: Support mailbox received 8 complaints about account resets and missing pets upon signing in.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Centered Path Selection Grid: Change path selection layout to a grid format to cleanly separate default pet selection from custom pet creation paths. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users with an extremely high mean duration of 514s, indicating layout confusion.)
7: [finish, notification] Completion Ready Alert Notification: Add an explicit system notification trigger prompt on the final onboarding screen before sending the user to desktop. (why: 3 support emails reported that the pet did not appear or users did not notice the pet launching on their desktop.)
